read bearer cannot PUT and reader execution role cannot write storage

a valid bearer cannot select or retrieve another namespace
empty, conflicting, traversal-like, encoded, and oversized selectors fail closed
invalid, traversal-like, encoded, empty, and oversized hashes fail closed
valid Turbo HMAC tag is preserved and accepted by the producing client epoch
signed client rejects a response with no tag and direct receipt identifies the cause
signed client rejects a modified tag without materializing outputs
signed client rejects modified bytes without materializing outputs

old and new namespace epochs do not silently cross-restore or downgrade to unsigned
401, 403, 429, 5xx, timeout, reset, and truncated body have distinct direct receipts
failed and ambiguous writes do not produce a success receipt or corrupt a prior object
concurrent identical and conflicting writes have a defined atomic result
readers observe either the prior complete artifact or the new complete artifact
